name: maqueta
description: Django backend + AI assistant wrapped around an existing visual HTML/JSON page editor. The editor keeps all of its manual features; the AI adds a panel that turns a natural-language instruction into **validated, structured operations** you preview and apply as a single undo step. A second AI-guided flow, the **template wizard** (`/wizard/`), builds a whole page from scratch through a chat + dynamic question form instead of starting from a curated template. The editor is served behind login and same-origin, so the browser's **session cookie (with CSRF)** authenticates the API — no API key ever reaches the browser, no token/device flow needed.
